scripts.text: - You have too many items. Please make space. -
scripts.translation: - 您的物品欄已滿，請騰出空間。 -

scripts.text:
[Catalog Magician]
Look... the Magic Academy
in Geffen is now directly
selling the brand new
^007777Universal Catalog Silver^000000!
scripts.translation:
[目錄魔法師]
看...吉芬的魔法學院
現在直接銷售全新的
^007777通用目錄 銀版^000000！

scripts.text:
He is looking at the words
written on his hand.
He seems too busy
to look at you.
scripts.translation:
他正看著自己手上寫的字。
他似乎太忙了，
沒空看你。

scripts.text:
[Catalog Magician]
A brand new catalog
has just come out!
You can check
what items you can trade
and what items are on sale
from the vendor.
scripts.translation:
[目錄魔法師]
全新的目錄剛出版！
你可以檢視
可以交易的物品
以及商家正在促銷的物品。

scripts.text:
[Catalog Magician]
The ^007777Universal Catalog Silver^000000
costs only 200z!
You can buy up to 50 pieces at once!
scripts.translation:
[目錄魔法師]
^007777通用目錄 銀版^000000
只要200 Zeny！
一次最多可以購買50本！
購買一本^007777通用目錄 銀版^000000

scripts.text: You don't look like a vendor!

[Catalog Magician]
You... want all 50 pieces?
Or how many do you need?
scripts.translation:
[目錄魔法師]
你...想要全部50本？
還是說你需要多少本？

scripts.text:
[Catalog Magician]
The trade has been stopped!
I don't know what to do next...
What should I do?
scripts.translation:
[目錄魔法師]
交易被中斷了！
我不知道接下來該怎麼辦...
我該怎麼辦？

scripts.text:
[Catalog Magician]
It should be less than 50 pieces.
scripts.translation:
[目錄魔法師]
應該少於50本。

scripts.text:
[Catalog Magician]
The total number of catalog(s) that you're trying to purchase is {0} pieces.
It costs {1} z.
It seems you don't have enough money.
You can sell your equipment
to make more money... if you want.
scripts.translation:
[目錄魔法師]
您試圖購買的目錄總數為{0}本。
費用為{1} Zeny。
看來您的Zeny不足。
您可以出售裝備
來賺取更多Zeny...如果您願意的話。

scripts.text:
[Catalog Magician]
The total number of catalog(s) that you're trying to purchase is {0} pieces.
It costs {1} z.
Ok, here you go.
scripts.translation:
[目錄魔法師]
您試圖購買的目錄總數為{0}本。
費用為{1} Zeny。
好的，給您。

scripts.text:
[Catalog Magician]
Argh... you really need this
item... Do you want me to
explain again? I don't know
what to do next...
What should I do?
scripts.translation:
[目錄魔法師]
啊...你真的需要這個
物品...你想讓我再解釋一遍嗎？
我不知道接下來該怎麼辦...
我該怎麼辦？

scripts.text:
[Catalog Magician]
My real job is a magician.
I was going to ask the merchant
guild to sell them, but they were
trying use them as an appendix
into broom sales. That's why
I'm selling these by myself.
scripts.translation:
[目錄魔法師]
我的本職工作是魔法師。
我本來打算請商人行會
來銷售這些目錄，但他們試圖
把它們作為掃帚銷售的附錄。
所以我才自己來賣這些。

scripts.text:
[Catalog Magician]
There are many adventurers
here who come and go.
I'm pretty sure that I can sell to all of them soon.
Don't you think so?
So... let's start!! Buy more of them, please! PLEASE...!
scripts.translation:
[目錄魔法師]
這裡有很多來來去去的冒險者。
我確信很快就能把它們全部賣完。
你不覺得嗎？
所以...讓我們開始吧！！請多買一些！拜託了...！
